content: Reads English books and casts household tallies
She will say when you have answered a question nobody asked.
She keeps an order, she corrects who to whom, and she had the queen right before she was told.
She keeps an order and a count, casts a slate, and will not correct her grandfather while he is in the middle of a story.
She can read his hand, and her note on the girl is the note he keeps.
She wants the verdict on too quick in writing, the other thing, not the line in which the girl says it herself.
